test_objective: Check that one can merge an entity

test_cases.name: 056_01_01 MergeAnEmptyEntity
test_cases.doc: Check that one can merge an entity
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entity_id}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Merge Entity and
    Query Parameter: entity_id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: entity_filename set to 'building-minimal.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json' and
    Query Parameter: context set to ''
}
